about: Phones that sent findings but have no profile yet, read by reports/devices.py. 'oneui' is what their latest findings showed (null: not kept). OneOS has Android 16 (One UI 8.x, OxygenOS 16 since 0.4.67) and Android 17 (One UI 9) images, so a phone qualifies once it runs One UI 8 or newer; then it gets a profile (memory: profiles-from-findings) and leaves this list. 'variantOf' puts a model under a supported phone's name; 'variant' is the model line shown. Renamed phones (a model whose codename or chip belongs to another phone, e.g. ports like a Note20 Ultra on an S22 Ultra build) and non-Samsung phones are left out.
